source: Codex re-probe c3 (interrupt during sleep 75), 0.159.2, 2026-09-30; interrupt reply and interrupted terminal arrived in one 2 ms read; the tool was alive at 65 s with no item/completed

params.prompt: Run the shell command sleep 75. Then say done.

expect.notes: Interrupt sends only turn/interrupt; {} confirms handling only, the matching turn/completed interrupted is the acknowledgement (C2 §6.2 Interrupt). The reported commandExecution item never completes, so run_turn returns at min(ack + tool_grace, wall) with cleanup uncertain (C2 §2 Interrupt table, §4.1; C1 P7). tool_grace_ms scales C1 P7's 60 s for the test. The commentary message is not final text. The shared server is never killed.
